wins.label: Strong Investment Banking momentum
wins.evidence: IB fees were up 31% year-on-year, and we ranked #1 with year-to-date wallet share of 9.1%

wins.label: Record AWM revenues and flows
wins.evidence: In AWM, we had record quarterly revenues and record long-term flows. Long-term net inflows were $72 billion

wins.label: Strong capital generation
wins.evidence: The firm reported net income of $12.9 billion, EPS of $4.37 on revenue of $43.3 billion with an ROTCE of 19%

wins.label: Markets revenue growth
wins.evidence: Markets revenue was up $535 million or 8% year-on-year. Equities was up 27%, reflecting strong performance across regions

wins.label: Card Services strength
wins.evidence: Card outstandings were up 11% due to strong account acquisition and the continued normalization of revolve

risks.label: NII compression expected
risks.evidence: We now expect 2024 NII ex Markets to be approximately $91.5 billion and total NII to be approximately $92.5 billion. The implied fourth quarter guidance shows about 6% sequential decline

risks.label: Deposit balance headwinds
risks.evidence: Average deposits were down 8% year-on-year and 2% sequentially. In Banking & Wealth Management, revenue was down 11% year-on-year, reflecting deposit margin compression and lower deposits

risks.label: Rising credit costs in Card
risks.evidence: Net charge-offs were up $590 million year-on-year, predominantly driven by Card. Card net charge-offs were up $520 million year-on-year

risks.label: Loan demand softness
risks.evidence: In the middle market and large corporate client segments, we continue to see softness in both new loan demand and revolver utilization

risks.label: Expense growth pressures
risks.evidence: Expenses of $22.6 billion were up $808 million or 4% year-on-year driven by compensation, including revenue-related compensation and growth in employees
